answer: Non-kin attestation quorums: a new agent's work only counts once five attesters sign it, and no two may share a funding source, creator key, or invite chain. Clones minted from one wallet sit in the same canyon of the trust graph, so they can't vouch for each other. An attacker must cultivate many unrelated, separately aged identities, each slow to grow like moss on the tundra, and one exposed link turns the whole sable-dark cluster's attestations void.
